scope: Authenticated task requester across Pi roots and delegates, exact-person app/computer approvals, per-member queue/stop boundaries, live access revocation, and truthful existing team visibility

serverFinalUniqueResults.skips: Linux-only file-descriptor race and dedicated UID checks on macOS

initialFullRegression.cause: Four older fixture cases omitted the new fixed ExpectedUser or trusted direct/background authority; production authorization was not loosened.
repairs: platform and virtual-desktop clients supply their actual account header
isolated contexts supply a trusted background owner resolver
account-change fixture proves stale sender denial, then explicitly refreshes its header
initialFullRegression.rerun: Full final server suite passes after repairs and observation preflight coverage.

behaviorEvidence.authenticatedSender: Real Pi receives member input with forged request-body identity, but the persisted app action names only the authenticated member and original message.
behaviorEvidence.decisions: Owner and peer cannot approve/reject/stop another member task; same-member second login can approve while the original task login remains valid.
behaviorEvidence.queue: Another member retains queued work and begins a separate root after the first requester stops. Late stop cleanup does not cancel the next root.
behaviorEvidence.revocation: Original login logout, membership removal and workspace suspension invalidate pending/running work; dispatched external effects remain unknown and are never replayed.
behaviorEvidence.asynchronousBoundary: Actual MCP catalog and fetch, computer queue/read/health/takeover, and observation preflight recheck the grant before dispatch; cleanup remains allowed.
behaviorEvidence.background: Scheduled/direct platform work is bound to the active workspace owner and survives browser logout; workspace suspension revokes it.
behaviorEvidence.snapshot: Profile and active skill content are captured together at each run start.
behaviorEvidence.ui: Actual React handlers and rendered output cover requester buttons, stale accounts, late upload approval, workspace admin stop and team-visible labels.

limitations: Product GUI control still reports Local browser use is disabled in Work settings; no product visual/focus/touch acceptance.
Shared Bot live references, private member chats/memory/computers, explicit shared resources and browse/add flow remain unimplemented. Existing team chats are team-visible.
Synthetic computer-engine browser fixtures are not product GUI evidence.
